subject: english
prompt: Which reply is most appropriate when a classmate says, “Could you lend me a pencil?”

options.text: The pencil is asking a question.
No, I could lent it tomorrow yesterday.

answer.explanation: “Sure. Here you are.” is a natural polite response to a request to borrow a pencil and provides the requested object.。正確答案為選項 A：「Sure. Here you are.」。最後把這個選項放回題幹，確認它同時符合題目條件與本單元判準。

solutionSteps: 讀題定位：先找出本題要判斷的核心條件與限制；題幹是「Which reply is most appropriate when a classmate says, “Could you lend me a pencil?”」。

建立本題判準：先記下題幹「Which reply is most appropriate when a classmate says, “Could you lend me a pencil?”」的要求，再用答案解析指出的核心理由「“Sure. Here you are.” is a natural polite response to a request to borrow a pencil and provides the requested object.」作為逐項比對標準。
核對正確選項 A：Sure. Here you are.。依題目解析，“Sure. Here you are.” is a natural polite response to a request to borrow a pencil and provides the requested object.
逐項檢查語言證據：對照主詞、動詞形式、語序、搭配與語境功能；正解 A「Sure. Here you are.」符合「“Sure. Here you are.” is a natural polite response to a request to borrow a pencil and provides the requested object.」，其他選項逐一指出文法或語意衝突。
最後回查：把答案 A「Sure. Here you are.」放回完整題幹「Which reply is most appropriate when a classmate says, “Could you lend me a pencil?”」，確認它同時滿足題目要求與解析理由；若條件、數字、語境或資料尺度改變，必須重新建立判準，不可只沿用答案代號。
